verdict.rationale: cubic documents an Analytics API, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and a probe of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.cubic.dev returned 404 for all of them. The llms.txt docs index and the MCP server are related agent-facing features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit here.
